title: mirror_timer
summary: MSUI strictly decodes the complete build-5875 mirror family: 21-byte START with signed scale and spell id, 5-byte PAUSE, and 4-byte STOP. The fixed three-slot state treats START as an idempotent full restatement and integrates value plus signed scale times elapsed between packets.

openItems.text: SMSG_START_MIRROR_TIMER not parsed (including the signed scale field and START-as-full-restate semantics)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the exact 21-byte body is parsed in server field order, preserving signed scale and START-as-full-restatement semantics.
2026-08-21: the exact u32 kind plus u8 paused body settles accumulated time and freezes/unfreezes the addressed timer.
2026-08-21: the exact u32 kind body releases only its matching frame.

openItems.text: No breath/fatigue/feign-death bar state or client-side integration of remaining_ms between packets
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: MirrorTimerState owns the fixed three-frame pool and smoothly integrates the server's signed per-second rate.
